segments.text_en: Inana made a decision to abandon cities and descend to the underworld
evidence: the goddess set her mind on the great below
My mistress abandoned heaven, abandoned earth, and descended to the underworld
She abandoned the... office of en, of lagar, the Eanna in Uruk..

segments.text_en: Grasping divine powers with different functions by Inana
evidence: She took the seven divine powers
She covered her body with a pala dress, the garment of ladyship
She pulled the pectoral “Come, man, come” over her breast
She held the lapis-lazuli measuring rod and measuring line in her hand

segments.text_en: Instructions of actions for the minister Ninsubur how to act during Inanna's descending
evidence: Holy Inanna says to Ninšubur
When I have arrived in the underworld, make a lament for me on the ruin mounds
Lacerate your eyes for me, lacerate your nose for me
set your foot

segments.text_en: Rounds of asking for help to Enlil, Nanna and Enki. Only the last one mentioned as one who will restore Inanna to life
evidence: lament before Enlil
don’t let anyone kill your daughter
precious metal be alloyed
precious lapis lazuli be split
If Enlil does not help you in this matter, go to Ur
And if Nanna does not help you in this matter, go to Eridu
Father Enki, the lord of great wisdom
He is the one who will restore me to life

segments.text_en: Starting point of the Inana's intruding to the underworld: with aggression and trickster reason
evidence: pay attention
Don’t neglect the instructions I gave you
she pushed aggressively on the door
I am all alone and I want to come in
How did you set your heart on the road whose traveller never returns?
in order to have his funeral rites observed

segments.text_en: Ereskigal is analyzing the situation and give to her doorman instructions how to mitigate the risk of Inana
evidence: It is Inanna, your sister, and she has arrived at the palace Ganzer
She has abandoned Eanna and has descended to the underworld
She has taken the 7 divine powers
When she heard this, Ereškigal slapped the side of her thigh
don’t neglect the instructions I will give you
let each door of the palace Ganzer be opened separately
crouched down and had her clothes removed

segments.text_en: Taking away seven divine powers from Inana, making her powerless
evidence: when Inanna entered
were removed from her hand
Be satisfied
a divine power of the underworld has been fulfilled
must not open your mouth against the rites of the underworld
they were carried away

segments.text_en: Inana seizures the throne of the underworld, being turned into a corpse, Ninsubur follows the instructions
evidence: she sat on her throne
the seven judges, rendered their decision against her
the look of death
the speech of anger
the shout of heavy guilt
the corpse was hung on a hook
her minister...carried out the instructions of her mistress

segments.text_en: Ninsubur asks two gods to save Inana, but they refuse to help
evidence: she laments before Enlil
In his rage father Enlil answers Ninšubur
My daughter craved the great heaven and she craved the great below
father Enlil did not help in this matter
In his rage father Nanna answers Ninšubur
for whoever gets them must remain in the underworld
father Nanna did not help her in this matter

segments.text_en: Enki creates specific creatures, give them the instructions how to act in the underworld
evidence: What has Inanna done? She has me worried
Enki helped her
Flit past the door like flies
let me talk with you; may a destiny be decreed for you
They will offer you...don’t accept it
Give us the corpse hanging on the hook
sprinkle on it the life-giving plant
let Inanna rise up

segments.text_en: Creatures return Inana to life, but the underworld requires a substitute for her
evidence: paid attention to the instructions of Enki
They made her swear this by heaven and earth
Whether it is that of our king or that of our queen, give it to us
the Anuna seized her
If Inanna is to ascend from the underworld, let her provide a substitute for herself

segments.text_en: Demons enclosure Inana on her way back; without eat, food, no offerings
evidence: though not a minister, held a sceptre in his hand
though not an escort, carried a mace at his hip
restrained her on all sides
take away the child

segments.text_en: Inana ascend and goes on through cities to find a substitute, she doesn't accept to turn over her allies
evidence: proceed to your city, we will take her back
She brought me back to life
How could I turn her over to you?
Šara, in his own city, threw himself at her feet
Outstanding Lulal follows me at my right and my left
Let us go on

segments.text_en: Demons seized Dumuzi, he is not showing the lamentation, he got the look of death from Inana
evidence: Dumuzi clothed in a magnificent garment and seated magnificently on a throne
The demons seized him
They would not let the shepherd play the pipe and flute before her
She looked at him, it was the look of death
Holy Inanna gave Dumuzi the shepherd into their hands
They never enjoy the pleasures
They snatch the son from a man’s knee

segments.text_en: Utu helps Dumuzi to escape his demons. How he was caught is unclear
evidence: Dumuzi let out a wail and turned very pale
I am your relation by marriage
Turn my hands into snake’s hands
so I can escape my demons
Utu accepted his tears
Dumuzi escaped his demons
having seized

segments.text_en: Inana has an emotional breadown, she looks for Dumuzi
evidence: Holy Inanna wept bitterly for her husband
She tore at her hair like esparto grass
where is my precious husband?
Where is my man?

segments.text_en: A fly helps to show Dumuzi and got a sparkling destiny
evidence: If I show you where your man is, what will be my reward?
Inanna decreed the destiny of the fly
You will live (?) like the sons of the wise

segments.text_en: Dumuzi and his sister become a substitute for Inana, each one for half the year
evidence: for half the year and your sister for half the year
Inanna gave Dumuzi as a substitute
sweet is your praise
